sv.title: 200-dagarsfesten hölls – trots åtal mot Sigtunaelever
sv.summary: Sigtunaskolans traditionsenliga 200-dagarsfest ställdes in efter kritik. Men på fredagskvällen hölls firandet ändå – i form av en maskerad. Samtidigt står sex sistaårselever åtalade för grova brott.

en.title: 200-day party held – despite charges against Sigtuna students
en.summary: Sigtunaskolan's traditional 200-day party was cancelled after criticism. But on Friday evening the celebration was held anyway – in the form of a masquerade. Meanwhile, six final-year students have been charged with serious crimes.
